name: Weapon Roulette
author: DrLegitamate
description: Going Commando picks Ratchet's weapon for you: every few seconds of play, or every few enemy kills, a random weapon he owns goes in his hand. Upgrades, experience, ammo and Mega versions are left exactly as they are, and you can still switch weapons yourself between rotations.

settings.name: Enable Weapon Roulette
settings.description: Off: the mod does nothing and Ratchet keeps the weapons you choose.

settings.name: Rotation Mode
settings.description: What brings the next weapon: seconds of play, or enemies defeated.

settings.name: Time Interval (Seconds)
settings.description: Time Based: seconds of play between rotations. Menus, vendors, cutscenes and loading do not count.

settings.name: Enemy Kills Per Rotation
settings.description: Enemy Kills: enemies defeated between rotations. Crates and scripted deaths do not count.

settings.name: Avoid Consecutive Repeats
settings.description: Never give the same weapon twice in a row while you own another one.

settings.name: Prefer Weapons With Ammo
settings.description: Only hand over weapons that can fire (the Sheepinator and Walloper always can). If only the weapon in hand has ammo, keep it. Off: any owned weapon, empty or not.

settings.name: Show Notifications
settings.description: Show the new weapon's name, the kill count and the last seconds before a rotation in the HUD.
